title: CBIC Circular No. 40/2026: Quashes Sec 129 Penalty on Same-GSTIN Stock Transfer Without E-Way Bill
snippet: GST Appellate Tribunal holds that stock transfer between identical GSTIN branches without intention to evade tax cannot attract Section 129 penalty.

title: MCA General Circular No. 04/2026: Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme (CCFS-2026) Extended to 15 September 2026
snippet: Ministry of Corporate Affairs extends CCFS-2026 allowing pending ROC annual filings (AOC-4, MGT-7, ADT-1) at 10% reduced additional penalties.

title: CBDT Circular No. 04/2026: Mandatory DIN & TAN Registration Advisory under Section 195 for NRI Property Purchases
snippet: CBDT issues advisory for buyers purchasing immovable property from Non-Resident Indians regarding mandatory TAN deduction under Section 195.
